sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Yellow Zirconia Tulip Gold Clavicle Chain
sourceNotes.rawContent: Brighten your jewelry collection with this elegant yellow tulip pendant necklace. Featuring a vibrant synthetic zirconia bud and shimmering crystal leaves on a gold-finished copper chain, this niche design offers a sophisticated, versatile look. Perfect for daily wear, this dainty clavicle chain adds a sunny, feminine touch to any outfit
